device_literal.semantic: The exact selected NUL-terminated literal names /dev/wmtdetect.

chip_literal.semantic: The exact selected NUL-terminated literal names persist.mtk.wcn.combo.chipid.

open_fd.semantic: The device literal is passed to open at 0xb5c with numeric flags 0x102. Returned descriptor is stored at 0x3008. Negative returns enter the sleep/open loop, whose repeated open site is 0xbbc and whose only exit test is descriptor nonnegativity.

property_parse.semantic: property_get at 0xbe4 targets the chip-key literal and a stack buffer; strtoul at 0xbf8 parses that buffer with base 16 and null end pointer. The candidate is saved in x24. A zero property_get return takes fallback.

property_acceptance.semantic: Low-word comparisons accept the listed chip candidates; 0x6797 is compared at 0xda8 and 0x0279 at 0xdb8. A nonmatching list result takes fallback at 0xfd8. The request base 0x80047700 constructed at 0xbdc..0xbe0 is preserved across these branches.

autok_property_gate.semantic: The accepted-property path enters external probing only when candidate low word OR 2 equals 0x6632; otherwise it branches toward common cache-set/completion. Thus accepted 0x6797 and 0x0279 skip this autok path.

property_probe.semantic: The external-property branch performs power-on, conditional external detection, chip query, autok if detection succeeded, and power-off. Autok result selects logging. A successful detect plus query -1 can repeat this probe with a counter initially 9, at most ten attempts; this loop is earlier than cleanup/init. The original property candidate is restored afterward.

fallback.semantic: Missing/unrecognized property enters external power-on/detection. Power-on failure or nonzero detection takes the SoC query at 0x1078 (base+3), storing its result as candidate and clearing the external flag. Zero detection branches to 0x1470.

external_query.semantic: External-detection success reaches GET_CHIP_ID at 0x1498 (base+0), saves its integer result as candidate and sets the external flag before joining at 0x1084.

query_property_update.semantic: The query-derived candidate is formatted and passed to property_set at 0x10c8 using the chip key. That return changes logging, not the candidate. Restored request base and the external flag control the following autok choice.

fallback_autok.semantic: The external fallback branch issues autok at 0x1140 (base+8) with the candidate scalar, then power-off at 0x1184 (base+7). Their returns choose logs. A -1 query candidate takes a sleep/log path before joining common completion; the SoC-query path skips this region.

cache_set.semantic: SET_CHIP_ID at 0x11e8 uses request 0x40047701 and the original candidate low word. Its return does not gate subsequent normalization or initialization.

normalization.semantic: Normalize 0x0321/0x0335/0x0337 to 0x6735, 0x0326 to 0x6755, 0x0551 to 0x6757 and 0x0279 to 0x6797. Other candidates copy through, with -1 taking the early failure path. In particular accepted 0x6797 remains unchanged.

cleanup_gate.semantic: Reload the stored descriptor; negative values skip cleanup/init. At 0x125c ioctl takes request base+5 and the normalized scalar. Only zero cleanup return branches to 0x1298; nonzero selects logging and skips module init.

module_init.semantic: The call at 0x12a4 uses the retained descriptor, request base+4 = 0x80047704 and normalized candidate in the 32-bit third-argument register, zero-extending it as a scalar. Its return is tested for zero; nonzero selects error logging.

init_zero.semantic: The zero-init-result branch prepares success logging and joins the same continuation at 0x12c8.

post_init.semantic: After logging, the stored descriptor is closed if nonnegative and invalidated. Later operations reach a different property_set at 0x13d8. Init return does not gate this continuation. No unrelated property literals or callee bodies were read.

routine_return.semantic: The later property_set result is saved at 0x13e4, survives the two logging branches and stack guard, and supplies this routine's return at 0x1438..0x1458. No process-entry caller is established.

invalid_candidate.semantic: Candidate -1 sets a local -1 return and joins the epilogue, bypassing cleanup/init and later property_set. A failed stack guard instead reaches its failure helper.

connection_declaration.symbol: integer chip argument and return declaration

state_model.routine: anonymous routine in [0xb10,0x14d0); not labeled main
state_model.open_retry: while descriptor negative; no local attempt limit
state_model.candidate_origin: recognized property low word, otherwise external GET_CHIP_ID or GET_SOC_CHIP_ID return
state_model.mt6797_condition: 0x6797 pass-through or conditional 0x0279 normalization; no unconditional platform constant
state_model.routine_result: later property_set return at 0x13d8; early candidate -1 returns -1
order: descriptor close and later property handling

identity_fd.claim: The fresh hash-matched ELF64 AArch64 input opens the selected /dev/wmtdetect path and carries the resulting stored descriptor into cleanup/init.
identity_fd.conditions: The anonymous routine must be entered, and an open must eventually return nonnegative. Negative open results retry locally without a count limit; static reachability is not observed execution.
identity_fd.missing: No missing local open-to-fd edge. Actual entry, device presence and runtime descriptor are not established by this static batch.
identity_fd.next_discriminator: Do not run the loader or probe a device. Any actual execution or startup-caller claim needs separate authorization and evidence.

init_request.claim: At 0x12a4 the numeric request is 0x80047704, matching the pinned COMBO_IOCTL_DO_MODULE_INIT encoding.
init_request.conditions: The word uses AArch64 Linux read direction, size 4, type 0x77 and number 4. Candidate must not be -1, descriptor must be nonnegative and cleanup must return zero. The source predecessor's kernel build guard still applies.
init_request.missing: No missing numeric construction or direct local-call edge. A live kernel's exact ABI and the external ioctl implementation were not observed.
init_request.next_discriminator: Keep the compatibility comparison pinned to the accepted source predecessor; it does not authorize an executable probe or mainline ABI.

scalar_origin.claim: The third argument is a property/query-derived normalized scalar. 0x6797 is conditional pass-through or the mapped result of candidate 0x0279.
scalar_origin.conditions: Property buffer is parsed base 16 and its low word matched against the recognized list; missing/unrecognized values use a kernel-query return. The W-register argument assignment zero-extends the scalar. The read-encoded command does not make it a pointer.
scalar_origin.missing: No missing local origin or normalization edge. Actual property/query value, complete parse validation and libc overflow/error behavior remain unobserved.
scalar_origin.next_discriminator: A runtime value or external-library claim needs separately admitted evidence; no second batch, binary or trace is allowed here.

local_return.claim: Cleanup status gates init. Init status only chooses logging and is not propagated or retried; later property_set status supplies the ordinary routine return.
local_return.conditions: Cleanup nonzero skips init. Both init-result branches join before close and later property operations. Candidate -1 has an early -1 return; external calls must return and the stack guard must pass for the shown ordinary epilogue.
local_return.missing: No missing local return-use edge. Separate libc negative-result conversion and the process-entry caller remain unresolved, so no process exit-status claim is made.
local_return.next_discriminator: Preserve the local-versus-process boundary. A different contract would be needed for external libc/startup behavior.

command_order.claim: Any selected autok precedes original-candidate cache set, normalization, cleanup and gated module init.
command_order.conditions: Recognized 0x6797/0x0279 property values skip autok. The recognized 0x6630/0x6632 branch conditionally probes/autocalibrates and can retry its probe up to ten times; fallback external query has another autok site, while SoC fallback skips it. Autok status affects logs, not the later init gate.
command_order.missing: No missing relative local-order edge. Runtime branch choice, external effects and resource lifetime are outside the static claim. The early probe loop is not an init retry.
command_order.next_discriminator: Do not translate the observed order into a safe executable protocol. A separate effects/ownership review is required before any hardware action.

mainline_boundary.claim: This is exact retained-vendor compatibility evidence, not a designed mainline userspace ABI.
mainline_boundary.conditions: The batch establishes addresses and conditional local semantics in a private binary against pinned source commands only. No standard-subsystem interface design or upstream error/resource contract is part of the item.
mainline_boundary.missing: A justified standard interface, ownership contract and reviewed error semantics are missing. Static binary reachability cannot supply them.
mainline_boundary.next_discriminator: Use a separately scoped standard-interface design if required; do not expose the vendor WMT ABI merely to execute this loader.
